---
title: "gsim: Slurm HPC Handoff Package"
---

This `gsim` feature candidate owns the Run Stage boundary between prepared Palace inputs and external HPC execution. It writes reviewable run folders, Slurm scripts, metadata sidecars, and handoff archives. It does not submit jobs or own site scheduler policy.

## Need

Notebooks should prepare a Palace run package without hiding solver execution inside the notebook. The package must be inspectable, portable, and resolvable after the external job produces Palace outputs.

## Native `gsim` Upstream/Main

`gdsfactory/gsim` upstream/main at `16f6ef6` has Palace simulation, mesh, and config generation. It does not have a canonical run-folder model, Slurm profile resolver, handoff archive manifest, or `PalaceSimBase.generate_handoff_package()`.

## Local Delta

The local branch `feature/gsim-palace-postprocessing-roles` at `1a3f48f` adds:

- [`gsim/src/gsim/palace/handoff.py`](https://github.com/arfiligol/gsim/blob/feature/gsim-palace-postprocessing-roles/src/gsim/palace/handoff.py) for Slurm profiles, scripts, metadata, and archive manifests.
- [`gsim/src/gsim/palace/run/`](https://github.com/arfiligol/gsim/tree/feature/gsim-palace-postprocessing-roles/src/gsim/palace/run) for run-stage implementation.
- [`gsim/src/gsim/palace/run_folder.py`](https://github.com/arfiligol/gsim/blob/feature/gsim-palace-postprocessing-roles/src/gsim/palace/run_folder.py) and [`run_stage.py`](https://github.com/arfiligol/gsim/blob/feature/gsim-palace-postprocessing-roles/src/gsim/palace/run_stage.py) for typed run-stage records.
- `write_slurm_sbatch_handoff()` and `generate_handoff_package()` on `PalaceSimBase`.

## Pipeline

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
    A["mesh/config ready"] --> B["write_config"]
    B --> C["write_slurm_sbatch_handoff"]
    C --> D["generate_handoff_package"]
    D --> E["External sbatch or copy step"]
    E --> F["Completed Palace run folder"]
```

- [Public Electrostatic Workflow](../docs/notebooks/public_electrostatic_workflow.ipynb)
- [Public Driven Workflow](../docs/notebooks/public_driven_workflow.ipynb)
